import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int b, l, c, ne;
        Edge(int b, int c, int l, int ne) {
            this.b = b;
            this.c = c;
            this.l = l;
            this.ne = ne;
        }
    }

    static final int maxn = 55;
    static final int maxt = 2 * maxn;
    static final int maxp = maxt * maxn;
    static final int maxe = 5 * maxt * maxn * maxn;
    static final int inf = 1000000000;

    static int[] egh = new int[maxp];
    static Edge[] eg = new Edge[maxe];
    static int ect = 1;
    static int N, M, K, C, D;
    static int[] cnt = new int[maxn];
    static int[][] id = new int[maxn][maxt];
    static int S = 1, E = 2, pct = 2;
    static boolean[] flag = new boolean[maxp];
    static int[] dis = new int[maxp];
    static int ans = 0;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static int rd(BufferedReader br, StringTokenizer st) throws IOException {
        while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null) return -1;
            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static void adeg(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        eg[++ect] = new Edge(b, c, l, egh[a]);
        egh[a] = ect;
    }

    static void ade(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        adeg(a, b, c, l);
        adeg(b, a, -c, 0);
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(flag, false);
        Arrays.fill(dis, inf);
        dis[S] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int p = q.poll();
            flag[p] = false;
            for (int i = egh[p]; i != 0; i = eg[i].ne) {
                if (eg[i].l == 0) continue;
                int b = eg[i].b;
                if (dis[b] > dis[p] + eg[i].c) {
                    dis[b] = dis[p] + eg[i].c;
                    if (!flag[b]) {
                        q.add(b);
                        flag[b] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[E] < inf;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int y) {
        if (x == S) return y;
        flag[x] = true;
        int tmp = y;
        for (int i = egh[x]; i != 0; i = eg[i].ne) {
            int b = eg[i].b;
            if (flag[b] || eg[i ^ 1].l == 0 || dis[x] < dis[b] + eg[i ^ 1].c) continue;
            int re = dinic(b, Math.min(tmp, eg[i ^ 1].l));
            if (re > 0) {
                tmp -= re;
                eg[i ^ 1].l -= re;
                eg[i].l += re;
                if (tmp == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return y - tmp;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            cnt[x]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++pct;
                if (i == 1) {
                    ade(id[i][j], E, C * (j - 1), inf);
                }
                if (j > 1) {
                    ade(id[i][j - 1], id[i][j], 0, inf);
                }
            }
            if (cnt[i] > 0) {
                ade(S, id[i][1], 0, cnt[i]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                    ade(id[a][j], id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                    ade(id[b][j], id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        int nn = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int aa = -1;
            do {
                Arrays.fill(flag, false);
                aa = dinic(E, inf);
                if (aa > 0) {
                    nn += aa;
                    ans += dis[E] * aa;
                }
            } while (aa > 0);
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
